findings.description: The dangling-link check uses path.resolve, which cancels `name/..` as text, but the kernel climbs `..` from wherever `name` really resolves. So a committed link that goes through a node_modules entry linked after the vet passes the vet and, when the stages run, resolves into <repo>/.worktrees/<sid>, the session's live worktree.

The dangling-link branch in `refuseEscapingLinks` re-inlines the "inside the checkout" test (`x !== inside && !x.startsWith(`${inside}/`)`). The same commit extracted that test into `escapesCheckout`, so the prefix rule now lives in two places and can drift.
